message.reasoning_content:
We need to read facts and determine applicable crimes under Chinese criminal law.

Facts:

1. On March 11 2013, defendant Sun X, together with Yang X (deceased) and Zhang X (separate case), in Qingta Village West entrance, due to trivial matter had a quarrel with victim Lv X, then Sun X together with Yang X, Zhang X etc beat victim Lv X, causing double-sided nasal bone crush fracture, double-sided maxilla frontal bone fracture, L4 left transverse process fracture. Medical鉴定: light injury (轻伤). So that's intentional injury causing light injury. Crime: "故意伤害罪" (intentional injury). Since injury is light, still intentional injury. Could be "故意伤害罪" (light injury). Also possibly "聚众斗殴罪"? But they acted as a group. However the fact says "伙同" (together). Could be "聚众斗殴罪" if they formed a group to assault. But the main is intentional injury. Chinese law: Article 234 (intentional injury) includes group assault causing injuries. Could be "聚众斗殴罪" under Article 293 (public order). But the fact: they beat victim causing injuries. Usually prosecutors charge "故意伤害罪". So we list that.

2. On Sep 5 2013, Sun X, dissatisfied with police handling, called 12345 hotline and fabricated false terrorist information about carrying TNT to the police station, causing police to take emergency measures, seriously disturbing social order. This is "编造虚假恐怖信息罪" (fabricating false terrorist information). Also possibly "扰乱公共秩序罪" (disturbing public order) or "危害公共安全罪"? The description says "严重扰乱社会秩序". The prosecution says "构成××、编造虚假恐怖信息罪". So they intend to charge "编造虚假恐怖信息罪" and maybe "扰乱公共秩序罪". The text: "公诉机关认为被告人孙×的行为触犯了《中华人民共和国刑法》××、××之规定，构成××、编造虚假恐怖信息罪。" The placeholders indicate two crimes: one is "编造虚假恐怖信息罪", the other maybe "扰乱公共秩序罪". So we list both: "故意伤害罪;编造虚假恐怖信息罪". Should we also include "扰乱公共秩序罪"? The fact says "严重扰乱社会秩序". The crime "扰乱公共秩序罪" (Article 293) covers group fighting, but also "扰乱公共场所秩序". However the specific law for false terrorist info is separate. The prosecution may charge both. The placeholder suggests two crimes: one is "编造虚假恐怖信息罪", the other maybe "扰乱公共秩序罪". So we list both.
